ASK ABOUT THIS CURRENT PLAY

Your current hand context will automatically be added to the search so you can investigate the exact situation.

SHOWDOWN — WHO WINS?
Read the board and the face-up hole cards. Choose the player with the best hand. If the best hand is tied, choose CHOP.
WHO WON THE HAND?
Select the player you are paying. The pot stays hidden here — you should physically push the pot to the winner first. After you select the winner, the trainer will add the full pot to that player's stack and carry all updated stacks into the next hand.

SEAT LAYOUT TUNER — LAPTOP PROFILE
Editing the LAPTOP profile. X: smaller = left, larger = right. Y: smaller = up, larger = down. Position/rotation controls are per seat. All resize controls are global.

Nameplate / Seat Anchor

Chair

Hole Cards — offset from nameplate

Bet / Chips — offset from nameplate

Dealer Button — offset from selected nameplate

Only the Dealer Button is shown in this room profile. Position and rotation are saved per seat. Dealer Button size is controlled globally below.

Community Cards — global table positions

Flop moves all three flop cards together. Use Flop Gap to bring the 3 flop cards closer together or farther apart independently of card size. Turn and River move separately. The BURN label and burn cards are hidden from the table.

Center Pot Chips — global table position

These controls move and resize the chip pile that remains in the middle after completed-street bets are pulled in. X/Y are offsets from the automatic under-board position, so the pot still follows the board if you move the community cards.

Blinds / Hand Box — global table HUD

Move or resize the BLINDS / HAND information box without changing the table, seats, cards, or rail. Positive X moves right. Positive Y moves down.

Audition Coming Soon Lock — PUBLIC PREVIEW

Move and resize the gray Audition lock exactly where you want it on the main menu. These controls are DEV-only. The public site will receive the final values after you approve them.

Global Nameplate Elements — applies to all 8 seats

Adjust these once. Every player nameplate uses the same money and seat-circle offsets.

Nameplate Inner Background — applies to all 8 seats

This moves/resizes only the black patterned background INSIDE the poker-chip border. The nameplate X/Y, rotation, border, player name, money, cards, bets and buttons do not move.

GLOBAL RESIZE CONTROLS — LAPTOP PROFILE

Every control in this section applies globally. Changing a size here resizes that visual element at ALL seats without changing any saved X/Y coordinates or rotations.
